text: Claude ran a reverse image search on Tbone's "Sea of Galilee" shot. Spoiler: it's not the Sea of Galilee. It's not even Israel. That's Jerash refugee camp, in Jordan — a real Anadolu Ajansı news photo from 2023.

Here's the actual article. Published October 31st, 2023 — two years before Gebeiner used it as his backdrop for a "right at the Syrian border" fundraising pitch. Somebody picked a stock photo of Palestinian refugees and built his border story around it.

The backdrop isn't the only thing worth checking. The account tied to Najib — Western Syria Development — has thousands of followers, a professional website, and a "Chairman"... who is never named. No individual, anywhere on the account or the site, is identified by name. That doesn't prove Najib isn't real. But it raises the question.

If we didn't have the stock photo Tbone used for the fake, how else could you know this is gen-AI? The Sea of Galilee sits 700 feet below sea level. There is no point on it where the far embankment isn't visible — and it's absent from the image Tbone lifted.
Don't be fooled by a greenscreen. If the backdrop's the only proof being offered, check it before you believe it.
